newsitem.title: USA: Elamex to make Nintendo system for Latam.
newsitem.headline: Elamex to make Nintendo system for Latam.

text.p: Elamex SA said on Monday that it had signed an agreement with Nintendo of America Inc to make the Super Nintendo Entertainment System for Mexico and the rest of Latin America.
Elamex Treasurer Jorge Torres said the company expected to start producing "within a few weeks."
The company's output during its first year would be a minimum of 300,000 units, he said.
"It will all depend on demand," he said.
Torres declined to say how much the contract was worth or how long it would last, saying only it was "more than one year".
Although he said the company's revenues would likely rise, he did not give a figure.
Mexico's Elamex makes computer-automated equipment to assemble printed circuit boards, among other things.
Based in Redmond, Washington, Nintendo of America Inc is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Nintendo.
